name: 奶茶棕调水光有色润唇膏款
description: 暖调有色膏体，半侧分屏即刻对比，九镜从干唇痛点到选色收口

styleLock.direction: warm milk-tea tinted lip balm commerce
styleLock.backgroundSystem: flat seamless paper only: pure white #FFFFFF for the packshot and the shade-dot screen, milk-cream #F3E7D6 for wear grids and the closing still life, toasted almond #A98F73 for portrait and surface-detail frames, deep cocoa #3E2E22 reserved for the tip macro field and for label plates; no environmental sets
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft warm 5200K studio key from the front-left with a low-contrast fill card, controlled wet specular on balm and coated lip surfaces, skimming highlight along polished edges, soft contact shadow under every upright product, no hard falloff
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper sweeps in #FFFFFF / #F3E7D6 / #A98F73 / #3E2E22, plus one low reflective shelf line used only in the closing still life; balm smears and dots always laid flat on paper so they stay grounded
styleLock.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif; one short headline plus at most one small label line per frame; every wording slot is a placeholder, never source wording
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in milk-cream #F3E7D6 plus empty unbranded label plates and dashed leader lines, left as reserved proof placeholders
styleLock.presentationRules: the product keeps one stable upright scale and one consistent silhouette on a slight eye-level axis; every lip crop stays from the philtrum or nose tip to below the chin with real texture; portrait frames use one generic model with no identifiable likeness; grid tiles keep identical framing, camera height and light
noDrift: no inconsistent lighting between grid tiles
no platform, marketplace or certification badges
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm milk-tea tinted lip balm ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, milk-cream #F3E7D6, toasted almond #A98F73 and deep cocoa #3E2E22 with one product-matched milk-tea accent; warm colour temperature throughout; flat seamless paper backgrounds only, no environmental sets; soft warm 5200K studio key from the front-left with a low-contrast fill card, controlled wet specular on balm and coated lip surfaces, skimming highlights along polished edges and a soft contact shadow under every upright product; modern geometric sans-serif with one headline and one small label maximum, every wording slot carried by a placeholder; thin single-weight line icons, empty unbranded label plates and dashed leader lines; stable upright product scale, all lip crops kept from the philtrum or nose tip to below the chin with real skin texture and no identifiable likeness; identical framing and light across grid tiles; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no platform or certification badges.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击：单品直立在一片摊开的膏体光晕上，用白底承接首图流量
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, product standing upright in the centre, full silhouette inside frame
shots.lighting: bright even high-key 5200K studio light, large soft front-left key with a low-contrast fill card, soft contact shadow at the base
shots.background: seamless pure white #FFFFFF with one wide translucent balm puddle spread flat behind the product
shots.props: none beyond a smear of the product's own balm
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, only an even clean margin around the silhouette
shots.promptTemplate: Product packshot photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The product stands upright in the centre, photographed straight-on at eye level with its whole silhouette inside the frame, rising out of a wide translucent puddle of its own balm spread flat on the surface behind it. Bright even high-key 5200K studio light, large soft front-left key with a low-contrast fill card on the shadow side, soft contact shadow grounding the base. Seamless pure white #FFFFFF background, the balm puddle reading as clear milk-cream #F3E7D6 with one thin glossy edge highlight. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame with an even margin all around and no extra whitespace. Square marketplace main image, crisp edges, true material rendering. Negative: no props beyond the product's own balm smear, no hands, no watermark, no invented seal or badge, no garbled or invented lettering on the packaging faces, no platform or marketplace logo, no star ratings, no gradient or textured background, no floating product without a contact shadow, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 先放大素唇的竖纹与暗沉起皮，让买家在对号问题上停住
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro from a slight high angle about 20 degrees above eye level, tight crop from philtrum to chin
shots.lighting: deliberately flat warm 5200K front light with no specular, faint shadow only inside the lip grooves
shots.background: full-bleed bare skin macro closed by a hairline toasted almond #A98F73 band along the outer edge
shots.whitespace: minimal whitespace, the bare lip surface itself is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point close-up tied to {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Extreme close-up macro taken from a slight high angle about 20 degrees above eye level, cropped from the philtrum to the chin with no eyes and no identifiable likeness; the lips are uncoated and matte so the vertical lip lines, dry patches and dull edge tone read clearly. Deliberately flat warm 5200K front light with no specular and only a faint shadow sitting inside the lip grooves, real skin texture with pores and fine lines fully kept. The crop runs full bleed with a hairline toasted almond #A98F73 band closing the outer edge. The bare mouth occupies 55-60% of the frame with minimal whitespace. Negative: no cracked or bleeding skin, no medical or dermatological imagery, no product tube inside the frame, no split-screen divider, no wording at all, no over-smoothed plastic skin, no watermark.

shots.intent: 同唇同机位的半侧分屏把干纹素唇与涂后水光并置，一秒给出结果证明
shots.camera: matched straight-on frontal macro panels of the same mouth, identical framing, camera height and distance in both halves
shots.lighting: one identical soft warm 5200K front key on both panels, wet specular on the coated half only, no hard shadow
shots.background: full-bleed matched skin panels split by a hairline dashed milk-cream #F3E7D6 rule
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, the two panels run edge to edge
shots.textZone: 两栏下沿各一条空白小色块位，供两条短标注
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce before-and-after comparison of {product} on the lips: two matched straight-on macro panels of the same mouth with identical framing, camera height and distance, split by one hairline dashed vertical rule. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The left panel is bare and matte, the right panel is freshly coated and glossy; one identical soft warm 5200K front key falls on both panels so only the surface state changes and the wet specular appears on the coated half only. Real skin and lip-line texture is kept on both sides with no retouch. Both panels sit full bleed and are divided by the dashed milk-cream #F3E7D6 rule; the two mouths together occupy 50-60% of the frame with no extra whitespace, and each panel keeps one small blank deep cocoa #3E2E22 plate along its lower edge reserved for one short label reading 「{callout_1}」 on the left and 「{callout_2}」 on the right. Negative: no fabricated or exaggerated result, no mirrored or duplicated panel, no numbers, dates or time values, no clinical or test wording, no eyes or full face, no wording outside the two label placeholders, no watermark.

shots.intent: 用一张通用买手式人像让买家代入上唇后的整体气质，承接对比之后的想象
shots.camera: slight 3/4 head turn at eye level, head-and-shoulders crop, one hand resting loosely under the chin
shots.lighting: soft warm 5200K key from the upper front-left with a broad fill card, gentle catchlight, glossy specular along the lip centre
shots.background: flat seamless toasted almond #A98F73 paper with no environment
shots.props: one pair of oversized flower-form earrings set behind the jaw line, never covering the mouth
shots.whitespace: generous negative space across the upper left of the frame for one short line
shots.textZone: 左下一枚空白圆形色块位加一行短标注
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle beauty portrait for {product}: a generic adult model whose face resembles no specific person, head turned in a slight 3/4 at eye level, one hand resting loosely under the chin, lips relaxed and glossy so the coating of {product} reads across the lip surface while the tube itself stays outside the crop. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Soft warm 5200K key from the upper front-left with a broad fill card, gentle catchlight in the eyes and one glossy specular travelling along the lip centre, real skin texture with visible pores and no beauty retouch. Flat seamless toasted almond #A98F73 paper background with no environment. Props: one pair of oversized flower-form earrings sitting behind the jaw line, never covering the mouth. The head-and-shoulders crop occupies 40-50% of the frame, with generous negative space on the upper left and one small blank milk-cream #F3E7D6 swatch dot low in the left corner reserved for one short line reading 「{callout_3}」 in deep cocoa #3E2E22. Negative: no more than five fingers, no fused or bent fingers, no hand covering the mouth, no recognizable celebrity likeness, no plastic over-smoothed skin, no dense body text, no invented shade name outside the placeholder, no watermark.

shots.intent: 仰角微距看清出膏口结构与膏珠形态，用四条引线把结构与体感讲成机制
shots.camera: very low angle looking upward along the dispensing tip, extreme close-up macro with shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: one soft top-front light plus a skimming warm key from the right sweeping a long clean highlight along the polished edge, soft shadow under the balm bead
shots.props: a single bead of the product's own balm resting on the curved tip
shots.whitespace: generous negative space ringing the tip for four leader-line callouts
shots.textZone: 出膏口四角四个空白色块位，以细虚线引向结构
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro detail of the dispensing tip of {product}, photographed from a very low angle looking upward so the tip rises through the frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A single plump bead of the product's own balm sits on the curved tip; shallow depth of field with the leading edge of the bead razor sharp and the body of the product falling off softly behind it. One soft top-front light plus a skimming warm key coming from the right that sweeps a long clean highlight along the polished edge, with a soft shadow pooling under the bead. Flat deep cocoa #3E2E22 seamless background with generous negative space ringing the tip. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame, and four blank milk-cream #F3E7D6 label plates float in the outer corners, each joined to the tip by a thin dashed leader line and reserved for one short note reading 「{callout_4}」, 「{callout_5}」, 「{callout_6}」 and 「{callout_7}」. Negative: no brush, wand or doe-foot applicator, no squeezed paste splatter, no greasy fingerprints, no invented material or ingredient naming, no dense body text, no wording outside the four label plates, no blurry subject, no watermark.

shots.intent: 在高光大膏面之上排四格图标位，用留空证明结构消除配方与质地疑虑而不编造
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down across a wide glossy balm smear that fills the field
shots.lighting: even warm 5200K top light with one broad soft reflection travelling across the wet surface, no hard shadow
shots.background: full-bleed toasted almond #A98F73 balm smear field overlaid with deep cocoa #3E2E22 plates
shots.props: none beyond the product's own spread balm
shots.whitespace: even gutters kept between the four panels, no extra margin clutter
shots.textZone: 2x2 四格区块，每格一枚线图标位加一行标题位与两行空白正文位
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust infographic screen for {product}: a high 45-degree angle looking down across a wide glossy smear of the product's own balm that fills the whole field, over which sits a two-by-two arrangement of four quiet information panels. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even warm 5200K top light sending one broad soft reflection travelling across the wet surface, no hard shadow, real texture and micro-bubbles kept inside the smear. Each panel holds one thin single-weight line icon in milk-cream #F3E7D6, one short title line and two blank body lines, laid on translucent deep cocoa #3E2E22 plates; the smear field reads in toasted almond #A98F73 fading to milk-cream #F3E7D6 at the highlight. The four panels occupy 50-60% of the frame with even gutters between them, the first panel title is the only wording slot and reads 「{callout_8}」, the remaining slots stay empty as reserved proof placeholders, and one hairline rule in {accent_color} underlines the header row. Negative: no ingredient names, no percentages or quantities, no medical or clinical symbols, no chrome three-dimensional lettering, no dense readable body text, no duplicated icon, no invented certification or test seal, no watermark.

shots.intent: 三种自然肤色的上唇四象限加一格膏面，让不同肤色的买家各自对号入座
shots.camera: matched straight-on close crops of the lower face in three tiles plus one flat top-down texture tile, identical distance in every tile
shots.lighting: one identical soft warm 5200K front key per tile, wet specular along the coated lip surface, no hard shadow
shots.background: seamless milk-cream #F3E7D6 field divided by hairline gutters
shots.whitespace: hairline gutters between tiles plus generous whitespace inside the texture tile
shots.textZone: 第四格膏面上一行空白色名位
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce four-quadrant wear grid for {product}: three matched straight-on close crops of the lower face only, each cropped from the tip of the nose to below the chin with no eyes and no identifiable likeness, on three different natural skin tones with the lips freshly coated, relaxed and glossy; the fourth tile holds a flat top-down swatch of the balm itself spread on paper. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. One identical soft warm 5200K front key in every tile so nothing drifts between them, wet specular on the coated lip surface, real lip lines and skin texture kept. The tiles sit on a seamless milk-cream #F3E7D6 field divided by hairline gutters; the worn lips and the swatch tile together occupy 40-50% of the frame, and the texture tile keeps one blank deep cocoa #3E2E22 line reserved for a generic shade word 「{callout_9}」 with generous negative space around it. Negative: no eyes or full face, no duplicated or mirrored tile, no arm or hand swatch streaks, no invented shade naming, no wording beyond the one placeholder, no plastic over-smoothed skin, no lighting drift between tiles, no watermark.

shots.intent: 俯视散点膏色把色域深浅一次摊开，给出选色入口而不给色号编号
shots.camera: flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle
shots.lighting: bright even 5200K top light with soft short shadows gathering at each blob edge, controlled wet rim highlight on every dome
shots.props: the product's own balm dots only
shots.whitespace: generous even white margins ringing the scattered dot cluster
shots.textZone: 每个膏点旁一枚空白小标签位
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant shade screen of {product}: a flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle showing five irregular jelly-like balm dots of different tint depths scattered across seamless pure white #FFFFFF paper, each with one tiny satellite droplet beside it. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Bright even 5200K top light with soft short shadows gathering at each blob edge so every dot stays grounded on the paper, one controlled wet rim highlight travelling across each dome, the tint range running from untinted milk-cream #F3E7D6 through toasted almond #A98F73 to deep cocoa #3E2E22. The dot cluster occupies 35-40% of the frame overall with generous even white margins, and each dot sits beside one small blank deep cocoa #3E2E22 label plate left unlettered as a reserved shade slot. Negative: no smeared stroke or swatch wand, no brush or applicator touching the dots, no trademark-style naming, no duplicated dot, no invented colour names, no wording on the label plates, no dropped crumbs or specks, no watermark.

shots.intent: 用置景静物的斜倚姿态与奶茶甜点符号收口，把色系联想转成下单冲动
shots.camera: straight-on with the camera at product height, the tube leaning diagonally against a footed cup on a low reflective shelf line
shots.lighting: soft warm 5200K key from the front-left sending one long clean specular along the tube, a gentle rim sweeping the cup, soft contact shadows where both pieces meet the shelf
shots.background: flat seamless milk-cream #F3E7D6 paper with a low reflective shelf line
shots.props: one footed polished metal cup holding a plain set cream dome topped with a single cherry, used only as a colour anchor
shots.whitespace: generous negative space across the upper 40% of the frame for one closing line
shots.textZone: 上部一条空白横幅位，仅一行收口文案
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce closing frame for {product}: the product leaning at a diagonal against a footed polished metal cup standing on a low reflective shelf line, photographed straight-on with the camera at product height so the diagonal silhouette carries the composition. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The cup holds a plain set cream dome topped with a single cherry, used only as a warm milk-tea colour anchor and never as a flavour or edible claim. Soft warm 5200K key from the front-left sending one long clean specular along the tube, a gentle rim sweeping the cup, soft contact shadows where both pieces meet the shelf. Flat seamless milk-cream #F3E7D6 paper background with a faint shelf reflection. The pair occupies 50-60% of the frame with generous negative space across the upper 40% reserved for one short closing line reading 「{selling_point_1}」 in deep cocoa #3E2E22. Negative: no melted, spilled or plastic-looking food, no insects or contamination, no unrealistic portion size, no hands, no price or discount wording, no countdown timer, no more than one line of copy, no clutter on the shelf, no watermark.

provenance.notes: 9 张参考主图逐图事实：①管身直立在一整片摊开的半透明膏体光晕上，白底单品主图；②同一张嘴的左右半侧分屏特写，左素唇哑光带竖纹、右涂后高光，中间一条虚线分隔，底部两栏原字样标注前后状态；③出膏口仰角微距，弧形导膏面上顶着一颗膏珠，四条虚线引线指向四段说明文字，暖褐色平铺底；④⑧两张暖沙灰底人像，一张为微侧头位配花朵造型耳饰，一张为托腮近距人像，唇面水光为主角，左下角各有一枚圆形色块与色名字样；⑤单品斜倚在金属高脚甜品杯上，杯内奶冻状圆顶与一颗樱桃，浅奶油底与低反射台面；⑥大张高光膏面铺满画面，上覆 2x2 四格说明块，每格金属质感小图标加标题加正文，顶部为金属立体字系列名；⑦四象限，三格为不同自然肤色的上唇特写，第四格为奶油色膏面并带色名字样；⑨白底俯视散落的五团果冻状膏色圆点加小卫星点，每点旁为色名与色调说明字样。品类判定：全套以色调与上唇妆效售卖（半侧分屏显色、多肤色上唇四象限、五团膏色选色卡、人像带色名圆点），属着色彩妆而非纯护理，故取 美妆彩妆／唇部，leaf 定为奶茶棕调有色润唇膏；源类目路径偏向唇部护理一类，按图改判。产品出膏结构为管身顶端弧形出膏口，画面中无刷头与棉签头，故分镜不含刷头上唇镜。与库内已有唇部模版的实质差异：色板改为暖奶油棕系（#FFFFFF／#F3E7D6／#A98F73／#3E2E22），避开雾紫与藕灰；新增素唇单幅痛点镜、半侧双联分屏对比、出膏口仰角机制微距、四象限膏面与上唇并置、俯视散点膏色卡、甜品台斜倚静物收口，并首次使用含完整人脸的通用模特人像。已剥离：原品牌字标与包装字样、原系列名与金属立体字、原色号名与色号编号、原模特身份与面容特征（人像改写为通用模特、唇部镜一律鼻下或人中裁切）、全部图内原文案原句、成分名称与含量百分比、去角质与丰唇等功效主张（四格说明块与标签全部改为空白证明位与空印章框）、任何平台与星级徽章角标。产品一律以 {product} 占位，仅保留分镜结构、机位、光位、色板与排版骨架。
